name: The Command Menu
description: You probably noticed the menu at the bottom left hand side of your screen. This is your Kingdom Keys $(thing)Command Menu.$() Navigating this menu is as simple as using your Arrow Keys.$(p)$(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.scrollup)]$() and $(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.scrolldown)]$() navigates the menu.$(br)$(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.enter)]$() selects and confirms.$(br)$(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.back)]$() cancels your selection.$(p)Alternatively you can also use $(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.scrollactivator)]$() and your Scrollwheel$(br)$(lissa)Attack$() is used to change the Keyblade you have equipped, use $(thing)[$(k:key.kingdomkeys.back)]$() to swap them.
